title: Loft square 20 to a point 10 up: Direction at the square, Point Tangent at the point (a dome)

expect.note: Each side line: from a square corner Q straight up (derivative 10 = 1 x 10), to the point arriving flat with derivative -(10 / (10 sqrt 2)) (Q - centre) (the corner's reach is 10 sqrt 2). The square at v has side 20 s(v), s = h00 - h11 / sqrt 2, at height z = 10 (v + v^2 - v^3) (Hermite h00 = 2v^3 - 3v^2 + 1, h11 = v^3 - v^2); V = integral 400 s^2 z' dv = 12800/7 + 3100 sqrt(2)/21.
